- Network access: May call external APIs, CLIs, MCP servers, or hosted services only when explicitly invoked by the user; keep account-backed operations out of shared defaults.
- File access: Reads and writes only user-selected project files, generated artifacts, reports, or local tool outputs when explicitly invoked; do not process private data without user intent.

- MCP, background services, and external binaries remain opt-in; do not auto-start them from this catalog row.
- Secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, cookies, OAuth grants, and account IDs must not be committed.
